messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: rapache 1.2.3 ubuntu builds
parts:
I published some new builds for rapache on ubuntu (for precise,
quantal and raring). To install:

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:opencpu/rapache
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install libapache2-mod-r-base

This will automatically install and enable mod_R. To uninstall:

sudo apt-get purge libapache2-mod-r-base

The repository currently contains:
- R 2.15.3.
- rApache 1.2.3

To remove this repository from your system, you can do:

sudo rm sudo rm /etc/apt/sources.list.d/opencpu-rapache*
sudo apt-get update

messages.subject: Re: rapache 1.2.3 ubuntu builds
parts:
I'm doing several projects now, I manage the versions though launchpad repositories. All opencpu and ohmage "production" repositories are on 2.15.1. The rapache and rapparmor repos have upgraded to 3.0.0.

I've gone back and forth between c2d4u. It has only 25% of all packages, and they can only target one version of R. Because packages are not compatible anymore between 2.15 and 3.0 it might be better to build them yourself at this point.

Also I am considering starting my own repo on github for cran packages that specify explicit dependency versions, the same way as julia manages packages: https://github.com/JuliaLang/METADATA.jl.
